grain_rationale: row_count is 166158 and duplicate_row_rate is 0.0, meaning no exact duplicate rows exist in the source, so each row represents one flight leg and grain_type is transaction. No single profiled column reaches a distinct_count equal to row_count (flight_number distinct_count 2994, tail_number distinct_count 3825), so a derived identity combining flight_date, carrier_code, flight_number, origin_airport, and dest_airport is used to uniquely identify each flight event; since duplicate_row_rate is already 0.0 this identity tuple fully absorbs any potential duplication without requiring aggregation.

fields.name: flight_date
fields.description: Calendar date of the scheduled flight, ranging from 2013-01-01 to 2013-06-30 with null_rate 0.0, used as a dimension to group flights by day.

fields.name: carrier_code
fields.description: Two-letter carrier code such as AA, DL, or WN across 16 distinct values with null_rate 0.0, a dimension identifying the operating airline.

fields.name: flight_number
fields.description: Integer flight number ranging 1-8500 with null_rate 0.0 and distinct_count 2994 below row_count, so it labels rather than measures and is a dimension.

fields.name: origin_airport
fields.description: Origin airport code limited to EWR, JFK, LGA (3 distinct values) with null_rate 0.0, a dimension describing the departure airport.

fields.name: sched_dep_hhmm
fields.description: Scheduled departure time encoded as an HHMM integer (500-2359) with null_rate 0.0, a dimension label of planned departure clock time.

fields.name: dest_airport
fields.description: Destination airport code across 100 distinct values with null_rate 0.0, a dimension describing where the flight landed.

fields.name: tail_number
fields.description: Aircraft registration tail number, nullable at null_rate 0.009154 (1521 nulls) for flights lacking a recorded tail number, a dimension identifying the physical aircraft.

fields.name: is_cancelled
fields.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the flight was cancelled, null_rate 0.0, a dimension flag usable to filter cancelled flights.

fields.name: dep_hhmm
fields.description: Actual departure time as an HHMM integer (1-2400), nullable at null_rate 0.029388 (4883 nulls) consistent with flights lacking an actual departure, a dimension label.

fields.name: dep_delay_minutes
fields.description: Departure delay in minutes ranging -33 to 1301, nullable at null_rate 0.029388 matching missing actual departure times, a measure summed or averaged for on-time performance analysis.

fields.name: arr_hhmm
fields.description: Actual arrival time as an HHMM integer (1-2400), nullable at null_rate 0.0307 (5101 nulls) for flights without recorded arrival, a dimension label.

fields.name: sched_arr_hhmm
fields.description: Scheduled arrival time as an HHMM integer (1-2359) with null_rate 0.0, a dimension label of planned arrival clock time.

fields.name: arr_delay_minutes
fields.description: Arrival delay in minutes ranging -86 to 1272, nullable at null_rate 0.032981 for flights missing arrival data, a measure used to compute average or total arrival delay.

fields.name: air_time_minutes
fields.description: Flight air time in minutes ranging 20-695, nullable at null_rate 0.032981 for flights without recorded air time, a measure summed or averaged to analyze flight duration.

fields.name: distance_miles
fields.description: Great-circle distance flown in miles ranging 80-4983 with null_rate 0.0, a measure additive across flights for total distance analysis.

fields.name: sched_dep_hour_local
fields.description: Scheduled local departure hour (5-23, 19 distinct values) with null_rate 0.0, a dimension label of the hour component of scheduled local departure.

fields.name: sched_dep_minute_local
fields.description: Scheduled local departure minute (0-59) with null_rate 0.0, a dimension label of the minute component of scheduled local departure.

fields.name: departure_hour_utc
fields.description: UTC timestamp of departure truncated to the hour, ranging 2013-01-01T10:00:00 to 2013-07-01T03:00:00 with all sampled values at the zero-minute mark and null_rate 0.0, the time column anchoring each flight event at hour grain.

fields.name: carrier_name
fields.description: Full carrier name such as Delta Air Lines Inc. or United Air Lines Inc. across 16 distinct values with null_rate 0.0, a dimension describing the operating airline in business terms.

fields.name: aircraft_manufacturer
fields.description: Aircraft manufacturer name such as BOEING or AIRBUS, nullable at null_rate 0.160426 (26656 nulls) for flights without matched aircraft metadata, a dimension describing the aircraft manufacturer.

fields.name: aircraft_model
fields.description: Aircraft model code, nullable at null_rate 0.160426 matching the manufacturer nulls, a dimension describing the aircraft model.

fields.name: aircraft_manufacture_year
fields.description: Year the aircraft was manufactured (1956-2013), nullable at null_rate 0.176531, a dimension label describing aircraft age rather than a summed measure.

fields.name: aircraft_seat_count
fields.description: Aircraft seat capacity (2-450), nullable at null_rate 0.160426 matching other aircraft attributes, a dimension describing aircraft characteristics rather than a transactional quantity.

fields.name: aircraft_engine_type
fields.description: Aircraft engine type such as Turbo-fan or Turbo-jet across 6 distinct values, nullable at null_rate 0.160426, a dimension describing aircraft engine classification.

fields.name: origin_airport_name
fields.description: Full name of the origin airport among John F. Kennedy International Airport, LaGuardia Airport, and Newark Liberty International Airport, null_rate 0.0, a dimension.

fields.name: origin_municipality
fields.description: Origin municipality, either New York or Newark, with null_rate 0.0, a dimension.

fields.name: origin_elevation_ft
fields.description: Origin airport elevation in feet (13, 18, or 21) with null_rate 0.0, a dimension characteristic of the origin airport rather than a summed measure.

fields.name: origin_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: Origin airport's longest runway length in feet (7002, 11000, or 14511) with null_rate 0.0, a dimension characteristic of the origin airport.

fields.name: dest_airport_name
fields.description: Full name of the destination airport, nullable at null_rate 0.02089 (3471 nulls) for destinations without matched airport metadata, a dimension.

fields.name: dest_municipality
fields.description: Destination municipality, nullable at null_rate 0.02089 matching dest_airport_name nulls, a dimension.

fields.name: dest_iso_region
fields.description: ISO region code of the destination such as US-AL or PR-U-A, nullable at null_rate 0.02089, a dimension.

fields.name: dest_elevation_ft
fields.description: Destination airport elevation in feet (3-6606), nullable at null_rate 0.02089, a dimension characteristic of the destination airport.

fields.name: dest_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: Destination airport's longest runway length in feet (5076-16000), nullable at null_rate 0.02089, a dimension characteristic of the destination airport.

fields.name: captured_at
fields.description: Ingestion capture timestamp ranging 2026-09-02T23:25:51 to 2026-09-02T23:26:06 with null_rate 0.0, a dimension recording when the row was captured by the pipeline, distinct from the flight's own event time.

category_description: One row represents a single scheduled flight leg departing JFK, LGA, or EWR during 2013, carrying its schedule, actual timing, delay, aircraft, and airport attributes.
purpose: This mapping declares how the silver.silver_flights table enters the gold unified event star as the flights fact category, naming the time column, grain, degenerate identifier, and field roles for the deterministic modeling engine that renders the gold models.
usage: The modeling engine consumes this mapping to generate the gold flights fact model; the proposal is rendered into an ODCS mapping contract, validated against the frozen mapping-contract schema, linted, and reviewed by a human before approval.
limitations: This mapping does not exclude cancelled flights (is_cancelled, null_rate 0.0) or rows with missing actual departure, arrival, or air_time data (null_rate up to 0.032981); consumers must decide whether to filter cancelled or incomplete flights. It also does not impute or reconcile the aircraft metadata gaps (null_rate 0.160426-0.176531) or destination airport attribute gaps (null_rate 0.02089).
